svg.title: Sign-in and explicit account-linking sequence
svg.desc: Three paths. Magic-link sign-in: the frontend requests a link through Better Auth at /api/auth/*, a verification row is stored, Resend emails the link, the browser opens it, Better Auth verifies the token, finds or creates the user and creates a session for user_A. Linked-provider sign-in (planned, #216): after the OAuth callback and state check, Better Auth looks up (provider_id, account_id), resolves user_A and creates a session. Explicit linking: with a valid session for user_A, the user connects a provider; after the callback Better Auth validates state, the session, the verified and matching email and identity ownership, then inserts an account row with user_id = user_A. user.id never changes.
